Remove Scientifically Inaccurate Planets
Removes all planets and celestial bodies with scientific inaccuracies for the optimal scientifically accurate Outer Wilds experience.

Outer Wilds is a game loosely based on real-world astronomy and orbital physics, but as anyone who has taken a high school physics class could tell you, the game is clearly not scientifically accurate at all. A black hole that doesn't spaghettify you? Trees that produce infinite oxygen? Sand passing back and forth between two planets? These are just a few of the many scientifically inaccurate things in the game. This mod removes all of the planets that are scientifically inaccurate, leaving only the ones that are scientifically accurate. The result is a much more realistic and scientifically accurate Outer Wilds experience.
